parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the toggle switch component of a wall switch, made of durable plastic. It is small and rectangular, designed to fit into the base body.
parts.Functional_description: The switch serves as the main control element that toggles the electrical circuit between ON and OFF states.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or pivotally along a small axis to change the circuit state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or faceplate of the wall switch, made of plastic. It is rectangular and serves as the mounting surface for the switch.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support and houses the switch mechanism, securing it to the wall and covering internal wiring.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
